title: Misty's Lounge
venue_description:
Misty's Lounge - Ontario's Premier Nightlife Venue

Located at the DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Ontario Airport Misty's Lounge stands as THE PREMIER night club in the entertainment capital of the Inland Empire. This sophisticated venue specializes in live music entertainment featuring international touring bands DJs and live performers nightly. The lounge caters to a mature adult clientele aged 21 and over seeking quality entertainment in an upscale setting.

Entertainment Programming

Misty's Lounge hosts rotating entertainment including live band performances from professional touring acts and DJs creating dynamic musical experiences. The venue is managed by Soto Entertainment Group an entertainment company established in 2000 that specializes in concerts nightclub operations artist placement and band booking services. The professional team ensures high-caliber entertainment and production quality for all events.

Music Genres and Atmosphere

The venue features diverse music programming including cover bands and tribute artists spanning multiple genres. The sophisticated lounge atmosphere with full service bar creates an ideal setting for adults seeking an upscale nightlife experience. Special themed events and rotating musical performances keep the entertainment fresh and engaging throughout the year.

Amenities and Services

Misty's offers convenient location at the hotel with parking available. Full food and beverage service provides dining options alongside drinks. The professional sound and lighting system ensures quality music reproduction. Two beverage minimum purchase required with first beverage within 15 minutes of arrival and second within two hours. Dress code enforced. Reservations recommended for peak evenings.

title: Raquel's Jazz Lounge
venue_description:
Raquel's Jazz Lounge - Upscale Jazz and R&B Venue

Located in nearby Rialto Raquel's Jazz Lounge is an upscale destination for sophisticated adults seeking quality jazz and R&B music in an elegant setting. This mature-focused venue emphasizes live musical performance in an atmosphere of refinement and good company. The lounge caters specifically to adults looking for an evening of quality entertainment music and cigar enjoyment.

Live Music Programming

Raquel's features live jazz bands performing Friday and Saturday evenings with R&B vibes on Friday nights. The venue maintains consistent weekend entertainment with professional musicians delivering classic and contemporary jazz standards. Thursday evenings feature Line Dance Classes providing community-building entertainment beyond traditional live music.

Musical Genres

The venue specializes in Blues Jazz R&B and Funk music creating sophisticated musical experiences. The intimate lounge setting with covered patio emphasizes music appreciation over dancing. The atmosphere caters to listeners seeking quality live jazz in an upscale environment.

Amenities and Experience

Raquel's offers a full service bar featuring premium spirits and wine selections. The covered outdoor patio provides a relaxed setting for cigar smoking and social gathering. Tacos and appetizers available during service hours. Soul-inspired food options complement the music and drink offerings. Thursday features a special Taco Tuesday promotion. Hookah available on the patio. Entry fees apply. Reservations strongly recommended for Friday and Saturday shows as the intimate venue frequently reaches capacity.

Dress Code and Policies

The venue maintains a strict dress code emphasizing casual upscale attire. The sophisticated crowd and atmosphere reflect the mature nature of the establishment. Must be 21 years or older. Parking available in the surrounding area.
